questions.question: In a row, J is 9th from the left. K stands 7 places to J’s right. How many people are strictly between J and K?
questions.explanation: A separation of 7 positions leaves 7 - 1 = 6 people strictly between.

questions.question: In a row, A and B are 10 places apart. They swap. Which quantity necessarily stays unchanged?

options.label: D
options.text: Number of people left of A

questions.explanation: The ranks a and b become b and a, so their sum remains a + b.

questions.question: P is 9th from the left and Q is 12th from the right. P lies left of Q. The number between them is an even number from 2 to 8 inclusive. How many total row strengths are possible?
questions.explanation: For gap k, total = 9 + 12 + k = 21 + k. Values k = 2, 4, 6, 8 give 4 totals.

questions.question: In descending height, R is above S and T; S is above U; T is above V. No other comparisons are known. Which pair’s relative order cannot be determined?
questions.explanation: R > S > U and R > T > V are fixed. Nothing compares S with T.

questions.question: A Bathinda help-desk task needs 75 minutes of work and one 15-minute break. It must finish at 12:20. What is the latest starting time?
questions.explanation: Required span = 75 + 15 = 90 minutes. Subtract 90 minutes from 12:20 to get 10:50.

questions.question: A row contains 24 boys and 21 girls. Mannat, a girl, is 10th girl from the left and has 13 boys to her right. What is her overall rank from the left?
questions.explanation: Boys to her left = 24 - 13 = 11. Add 9 girls ahead and Mannat herself: 11 + 9 + 1 = 21.

questions.question: A row has 56 people, with P at left rank 24. Remove the first 5 people and every person originally at ranks 30 through 36. Then insert 3 people immediately before P and 2 at the right end. Find P’s new right rank.
questions.explanation: New total = 56 - 5 - 7 + 5 = 49; P’s left rank = 24 - 5 + 3 = 22. Right rank = 49 - 22 + 1 = 28.

questions.question: 4 stages are Registration, Screening, Interview and Verification. Screening is after Registration but before Interview. Verification is after Registration but before Screening. Which stage is third?
questions.explanation: The order is Registration, Verification, Screening, Interview. Screening is third.

questions.question: There are 18 people ahead of Pari and 27 behind her. What is Pari’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Back rank counts the 27 behind plus Pari: 27 + 1 = 28.

questions.question: A stands at left rank 12 and B at left rank 31. How many people must be added strictly between them so that their positional gap becomes 24?
questions.explanation: Their current positional gap is 31 - 12 = 19. Each insertion increases it by 1, so 24 - 19 = 5 are needed.

questions.question: Row I has 20 seats and Row II has 18 seats, facing each other. From a fixed page-left, Row II seat 1 is opposite Row I seat 3. A is 7th from the right in Row I. What is the rank from the fixed page-right in Row II of the person opposite A?
questions.explanation: A is at Row I left 14, opposite Row II left 12. Row II right rank = 18 - 12 + 1 = 7.

questions.question: A teacher plans to reach a school 20 minutes before assembly. She is delayed by 28 minutes relative to her plan and arrives at 08:18. When was assembly scheduled?
questions.explanation: Actual arrival is 28 - 20 = 8 minutes after assembly time. Scheduled assembly = 08:18 - 8 = 08:10.

questions.question: Among A, B, C and D, A is older than exactly 2 people; B is the youngest; C is older than A. Who is second youngest?
questions.explanation: The descending age order is C > A > D > B. D is second youngest.

questions.question: For a candidate, top rank exceeds bottom rank by 15 in a list of 68. Find the top rank.
questions.explanation: Top + bottom = 69 and top - bottom = 15. Top = (69 + 15)/2 = 42.

questions.question: At actual 18:00, a clock is 20 minutes fast. It loses 5 minutes per true hour. At what actual time does it first become correct?
questions.explanation: Time to remove the 20-minute lead = 20/5 = 4 true hours. Add 4 hours to 18:00 to get 22:00.

questions.question: A merit list has 80 names. Removing some names below R changes R’s bottom rank from 31 to 22 but leaves the top rank unchanged. How many names were removed?
questions.explanation: Only names below R were removed, so the bottom-rank reduction equals their count: 31 - 22 = 9.

questions.question: The 1st of a 30-day month is Sunday. What weekday is the 1st of the next month?
questions.explanation: The next 1st is 30 days later; 30 mod 7 = 2. Sunday + 2 days = Tuesday.

questions.question: A girl is 12th girl from the left and 8th girl from the right. There are 23 boys in the row. Find the total number of students.
questions.explanation: Girls = 12 + 8 - 1 = 19. Total students = 19 + 23 = 42.

questions.question: In a 43-person row, X is left 8, Y is left 22, and Z is right 6. X swaps with Y, then Y swaps with Z. What is the sum of X’s and Y’s final right ranks?
questions.explanation: X finishes at left 22, right 22. Y finishes at Z’s original place, right 6; sum = 22 + 6 = 28.

questions.question: Two tests last 55 and 70 minutes with a 25-minute gap. The second test ends at 13:40. When did the first test start?
questions.explanation: Total span = 55 + 25 + 70 = 150 minutes. 13:40 - 2 hours 30 minutes = 11:10.

questions.question: R is 14th from the right in a fixed row. She moves 5 places towards the left. What is her new rank from the right?
questions.explanation: Moving left increases the right rank: 14 + 5 = 19.

questions.question: A hall admits visitors from actual 10:15 through 10:40, both included. A watch is always 6 minutes fast. Which reading on that watch is outside the admission window?
questions.explanation: On the fast watch, the allowed interval is 10:21 through 10:46. Thus 10:47 is outside it.

questions.question: A is 18th from the left and B is 14th from the right. They are distinct, but no order or gap is specified. Which statement is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: There is no finite maximum total

questions.explanation: Increasing the total can place B arbitrarily far to A’s right while preserving both ranks. Thus no finite maximum follows.

questions.question: A dispenser releases a token at 11:07 and every 16 minutes thereafter. What is the time of its 9th release, counting 11:07 as the first?
questions.explanation: The 9th release follows 8 intervals: 8 × 16 = 128 minutes. 11:07 + 128 minutes = 13:15.

questions.question: A is left 9 and B is left 36. A person must sit exactly midway between them in an occupied seat, with everyone retaining their positions. Which conclusion is valid?

options.label: B
options.text: No single seat is exactly midway

questions.explanation: The midpoint is (9 + 36)/2 = 22.5. It lies between seats 22 and 23, not at a single seat.
